questions.prompt: An ID3 node has two candidate tests. Test A gives a larger information gain than test B. What does that comparison mean?
questions.explanation:

Sources:
sa3/docs/dTree/Decision Tree.pdf, page 4

choices.text: A has higher entropy in every child than B.
A guarantees higher accuracy on unseen data.

choices.text: Insufficient training fit from a tree that is too simple.

High variance from overfitting.

questions.prompt: At a regression-tree node, split A has child MSEs 1 and 9 with child weights 0.9 and 0.1. Split B has child MSEs 3 and 3 with weights 0.5 and 0.5. Which split has the lower weighted MSE?
questions.explanation:
A: 0.9×1 + 0.1×9 = 1.8. B: 0.5×3 + 0.5×3 = 3.0. CART compares child errors weighted by their sample proportions.

choices.text: A, because its weighted MSE is 1.8 versus 3.0 for B.
